title: SWF: Header frameCount matches actual scene frame count
description: Unit test that the SWF file header frameCount field correctly reflects the total frame count of the document. For a 10-frame single-scene doc, the header frameCount should be 10. For a multi-scene doc with 5+8 frames, frameCount should be 13. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/framecount.test.ts.
